text: A Song. A Psalm of David. 1 My heart being firm, O God, I will sing and make music, even with my glory!
Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn!
I will praise You among the peoples, O YHWH, and I will sing praises to You among the nations.
For great over the heavens [is] Your loving devotion, and up to the clouds [is] Your faithfulness.
Be exalted above the heavens, O God, and over all the earth Your glory!
That Your beloved may be delivered, save [with] Your right hand, and answer me!
God has spoken from His holy place: “I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and measure out the Valley of Succoth.
Unto Me [is] Gilead, unto Me [is] Manasseh; and Ephraim [is] the strength of My head, Judah [is] My scepter.
Moab [is] the basin of My washing; upon Edom I will cast My sandal; over Philistia I will shout in triumph.”
Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me as far as Edom?
Have You not, O God, cast us off? And will You no longer go forth, O God, with our armies?
May You give to us help from adversity, and the salvation of man [is] emptiness.
With God we will act [in] strength, and He will trample our adversaries.
